query:
UPDATE agents g
            SET wallpaper = $3, wallpaper_revision = g.wallpaper_revision + 1
            FROM human_accounts a
            WHERE a.id = $1
              AND a.active
              AND g.id = $2
              AND (
                a.role = 'administrator'
                OR EXISTS(
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM effective_human_grants p
                    WHERE p.actor_id = a.id
                      AND p.scope_kind = 'agent'
                      AND p.scope_id = g.id
                      AND p.capability = 'agent.manage'
                )
              )
